'''grendelX Senate Droid Invasion & Sandspeeders v1.2 (LS)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 13 March 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine|Premiere-L-tatooine.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8)|VS8O-05-Careful_Planning.png|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 Tatooine grendelX LS 2005 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Careful Planning (V), Bargaining Table (V), Wokling (V), Ardon 'Vapor' Crell, Bo Shek (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Tawss Khaa (V), Bright Hope (V), Tantive IV (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Both decks went 1-1  to finish 4(-59) for 6th out of 8  players today...

* 1x {{CardLink|Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-wiseadvice.gif|label=Wise Advice}}

Ten shields posted after An Unusual Amount of Fear in the Light Side list, all named (Reflections III shields; Traffic Control (V) is the Virtual Set 3 shield).

== Notes ==

* Second deck in GPN post 5949; the Dark deck is on the (DS) page. The Light list has no section headers; total 60.
* No objective. Starting: Tatooine, Tatooine: Desert, Tatooine: Jundland Wastes, An Unusual Amount Of Fear, and Careful Planning (V) (a Starting Interrupt) with Bargaining Table (V), Strike Planning, Wokling (V) and Yarna d'al' Gargan.
* Careful Planning (V) and Bargaining Table (V) exist only as Virtual Set 8 printings (Careful Planning also as a VS0 preview); both are marked (v) in the post, so the VS8 pages are used (VS8 release date unproven). Tawss Khaa (V) x2 and Tantive IV (V) are Virtual Set 7 (legal from 2004-07-19).
* Other original-era (V): Bo Shek (V) (VS1); Wokling (V) (VS3); Commander Luke Skywalker (V) x2 and General Carlist Rieekan (V) (VS4); Bright Hope (V) (VS6). The draft (merged list) had dropped the (V) on Commander Luke, Rieekan and Bright Hope.
* Posted 'Arden "Vapor" Crell' dested Ardon 'Vapor' Crell; 'BoShek (v)' Bo Shek (V); 'Farm' the Special Edition generic site.
